About

The brand story placeholder

This page gives the prototype trust signals and turns the site into more than a pretty product catalog.

Cherry Wink is a soft accessory concept.

For this demo, the brand sits between playful and polished: girly enough to feel charming, restrained enough to feel elevated, and simple enough to merchandise cleanly.

The current goal is not to finalize copywriting, but to prove the information architecture of an actual store: homepage, collection, product detail, cart, checkout placeholder, and trust-building pages.

Positioning

Soft but not sugary

The visual language borrows from Emi Jay's clean femininity while adjusting it for a more accessible, Yiwu-sourced assortment.

Assortment

Built for a real demo

Claw clips, bows, scrunchies, bracelets, and a few small lifestyle add-ons help the prototype feel like a complete store.

Keep in touch

Sign up for launches, special edits, and first access to new drops.
